# Diagnosis (machinery evidence, REQ-XB-125 — discordance repaired, never excluded):
#   The allowed astral.sh:443 CONNECT tunnel pumped the client's ~800 B up and ZERO bytes
#   down for ~300 s until curl's timeout — the single-threaded sequential mediator
#   (hh_egress_mediator.rs: for conn in listener.incoming() { serve_conn(...) }) plus the
#   blocking tunnel pump (egress.rs forward_tunnel: std::io::copy both directions, no
#   concurrency) starved the HTTPS leg — the audit's D8/D9, matching Wc7's CONNECT-hang
#   evidence. denied_hosts: [] on every cell — the requests were ALLOWED; this is a
#   machinery discordance, never an allowlist_gap. The max_body 128MiB + duplicate-Host
#   repairs held: apt's whole update+install flowed through the same mediator (curl's own
#   .deb installed); only the CONNECT tunnel starved.
